Next-batch discovery completed at `origin/main` revision `4d6c1cc835e09f9ba70ef8373dca140cb6f2b699`. Fresh external and internal agents independently confirmed current drift in operation-certificate guidance, import recovery guidance, CLI discovery, MCP summaries, configuration ownership, event and migration references, architecture cutover state, concurrency anchors, and contributor retry guidance. F11 is removed from the pending register because current canonical create and transition help now includes its formerly missing options.

The first discussion batch sent to independent filtering contains a split F08 ticket-workflow correction, a split F08 installation and provider correction, F09, F10, F12, F13, and F19. The filter must reject or revise any item that is stale, duplicates an open owner, reopens F02 through F04, decides F05, adds mechanical prose enforcement, changes behavior under a documentation label, or lacks a current source of truth and historical basis. Other confirmed candidates remain pending for later batches.
